about: Whose Anthropic key pays for a Claude call (aiKeys.cjs). Each key is stored on the AI Gateway's Provider Keys page under its alias; nothing here is secret. A key with resetEvery "month" holds use-it-or-lose-it credit that lapses and refills on each monthly anniversary of resets; a key without it lapses for good at expires. Per use, the keys still able to pay are tried by whose credit lapses soonest (the current period's end, or expires), then file order. A key is skipped while retiredUntil is in the future, after a one-off expires, or once usedUsd (as of usedAsOf, within the current period) reaches capUsd. The gateway also rests a key on its own when Anthropic refuses it (credit spent or usage limit).
